about: kb-v2 C5 query hints (app/kb/query_hints.py). Retrieval only: when a trigger appears in the question (whole word, any case) and no 'unless' word does, the hint's search terms are appended to the query before it is embedded. Terms name where the law is (Acts, sections, procedural words), never what it says or concludes. Applied only with KB_V2 and QUERY_HINTS on. Evaluated in docs/query_hints_eval_2026-10-07.md.
